blocks.md:
## Quotes change the type

`42` (no quotes) is the number forty-two. `"42"` (quotes) is text that looks like 42. They are not the same kind of value.

blocks.promptMd: What kind of value is each of these?
blocks.explainMd: No quotes → number. Quotes → string. The digits can be the same; the quotes decide the type.

description: Choose an answer for every row, using the same choices.
